rows.text: Hey, my dear friend! Stick around, because the most mind-blowing magic show in this Amber Era is about to start!
rows.speaker: Mr. Jigsaw

rows.text: You might have noticed the incredible maze behind me. No one will ever find their way out of it.
rows.speaker: Mr. Jigsaw

rows.text: And now, the show is about to begin. Sit tight and join in.
rows.speaker: Mr. Jigsaw

rows.text: Get ready for a thrilling adventure! When the last three puzzle pieces fall into place, I'll reshape the maze, and the magician's secret treasure will be revealed to you!
rows.speaker: Mr. Jigsaw
